title: Malang Jazz Night
summary: An open-air evening of jazz standards and original sets from East Java's touring quartet, Ruang Nada.
description: Ruang Nada returns to Malang for one night only, pairing a full brass section with the city's own street-food vendors along the perimeter. Bring a mat — the lawn seating is first come, first served, and the covered stage seating is reserved for ticket holders.

title: Startup Founders Meetup Vol. 9
summary: Monthly gathering for early-stage founders — three lightning pitches, one investor panel, open networking.
description: This month's panel focuses on fundraising outside Jakarta: what regional investors actually look for, and how to build traction metrics that travel well in a pitch deck. Doors open thirty minutes before the first pitch.

title: Clay & Glaze Workshop
summary: A full-day hand-building session ending with your own glazed mug, fired and shipped two weeks later.
description: No wheel experience needed. You'll learn pinch, coil, and slab techniques, choose a glaze from twelve house colors, and leave with clay under your nails and a claim ticket for pickup once the kiln does its work.

title: East Java Campus Hackathon
summary: 24 hours, five-person teams, one theme announced at kickoff. Mentors on the floor the entire time.
description: Teams are self-formed or matched at the door. Meals, coffee, and a mentor rotation from local tech companies are included in the registration fee. Judging happens live, and the top three teams present to a public audience before prizes are announced.

title: Harvest Night Market
summary: Sixty stalls, live acoustic sets on three corners, and a lantern walk once the sun goes down.
description: The entry fee goes directly to the heritage street's upkeep fund. Cash is preferred at most stalls, though a handful now accept QRIS. The lantern walk begins promptly at 18:30 from the clock tower.

title: Children's Storytelling Day
summary: A morning of read-alouds, puppet shows, and a book-swap table for kids aged 4 to 10.
description: Bring a gently used children's book to swap, or take one home for free even without bringing one. Volunteers read in both Bahasa Indonesia and English on alternating sessions.
